rows.corpus_definition: Feeling a strong need for help because of a very bad situation.
rows.example_en: They made a desperate attempt to save the sinking ship.

rows.corpus_definition: a form of a language spoken in one region or by one group
rows.example_en: People in that village speak an old local dialect.

rows.corpus_definition: working very hard and carefully over a long time
rows.example_en: The diligent student reviewed her notes every evening.

rows.corpus_definition: To think that something or someone is wrong or bad.
rows.example_en: My parents strongly disapprove of my new hobby.

rows.corpus_definition: The ability to control your behavior to achieve something.
rows.example_en: He has the discipline to practice daily.

rows.corpus_definition: to make someone feel less confident or less willing to do something
rows.example_en: Constant criticism can discourage even the best students.

rows.corpus_definition: To treat some people worse than others because of who they are.
rows.example_en: It is wrong to judge people based on their skin color.

rows.corpus_definition: the loss of respect and honor due to shameful behaviour
rows.example_en: His dishonesty brought disgrace upon his entire family.

rows.corpus_definition: Changing your look so that people do not recognize you.
rows.example_en: He wore a disguise to hide his face.

rows.corpus_definition: To tell someone they are no longer needed at work.
rows.example_en: The company had to dismiss several workers.
